description: Scan a local repository and write a single self-contained HTML file with an interactive architecture map: compound boxes per directory, nodes coloured by heuristic layer, click-to-highlight callers (cyan) and dependencies (red), fuzzy search, collapsible directories and a minimap. Use it when a person wants to look at or share the architecture; use scan_repository_graph when you need the data as JSON, or query_impact_path for the blast radius of one file. Returns { success: true, filePath, nodeCount } where filePath is the absolute path of the written file, which you can open in a browser. Every call performs its own fresh static scan of `path`; no prior scan is required. The HTML embeds the repository file paths and graph data, so treat it as repository information when sharing. The page loads pinned Cytoscape.js libraries from a public CDN when opened; nothing else leaves the machine.

outputPath.description: Where to write the HTML file. Default "./repograph.html". A relative value is resolved against `path` (the repository root); an absolute value is used as-is, e.g. "/tmp/arch.html". Parent directories are created.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository root to scan, e.g. "/home/me/project" or "C:/dev/project". Relative paths resolve against the MCP server process working directory, which is usually not the project, so prefer absolute paths.

theme.description: Colour theme of the generated page: "dark" (slate background, default), "light", or "matrix" (black and green).

name: generate_architecture_html
title: Generate interactive architecture map (HTML)
